title: workspace-topic-lease.v1
description: Portable, host-neutral lease metadata for workspace/topic isolation. Identifiers are opaque full identifiers (not assumed UUIDs). This schema describes metadata only; it MUST NOT carry prompt bodies, secrets, environment values, or CMUX_* values. The session-input-guard enforces a strict allowlist and fails closed on unknown or forbidden-named fields.

schema_version.description: Lease schema version. Must be 1 for v1.

workspace_id.description: Opaque full workspace identifier. Host-neutral; format is not assumed to be a UUID.

session_id.description: Opaque full session identifier within the workspace.

lease_id.description: Opaque full lease identifier keyed by workspace+session+lease.

topic_id.description: Opaque full topic identifier the lease is working on.

epoch.description: Monotonic epoch. Bumped on accepted redirect or supersede to invalidate stale arrivals.

status.description: Lease lifecycle status. 'superseding' queues arrivals until a validated resume packet replaces the lease.

write_owner.description: The single worktree write owner. The lease is a routing guard/cross-check, NOT a second write grant.

supersede_target_epoch.description: The exact epoch a supersede is targeting. Must match the active lease epoch or the supersede is denied as stale.

resume_packet_ref.description: Resume-packet reference associated with a transition. Validation is attested separately by the owning adapter; presence alone is not proof of validation.
